description: US patent applications from the USPTO Open Data Portal, front-page data. company_name searches USPTO live on the first-named applicant over its full history; without it, or on a USPTO outage, rows come from a cached recent slice of a dozen large filers (source:'cache'). since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on filing_date. Default: filing_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_corporate_patents

company_name.description: Legal applicant entity, e.g. 'Google LLC', not 'Google'.

name: get_corporate_patents
